Cytoscape.js 3.34.3 and its layout extensions – the drawing of the Networks tab.

The files are the distribution builds from npm, unmodified:

  cytoscape.min.js        cytoscape 3.34.3, dist/cytoscape.min.js
                          https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js – MIT licence, (c) The Cytoscape
                          Consortium (LICENSE-cytoscape.txt)
  layout-base.js          layout-base 2.0.1, layout-base.js – MIT, (c) iVis@Bilkent (LICENSE-layout-base.txt)
  cose-base.js            cose-base 2.2.0, cose-base.js – MIT, (c) iVis@Bilkent (LICENSE-cose-base.txt)
  cytoscape-fcose.js      cytoscape-fcose 2.2.0, cytoscape-fcose.js – the fCoSE layout; MIT, (c) iVis-at-Bilkent
                          (LICENSE-cytoscape-fcose.txt)
  cytoscape-dagre.min.js  cytoscape-dagre 4.0.1, dist/cytoscape-dagre.min.js – the hierarchical layout; MIT,
                          (c) The Cytoscape Consortium (LICENSE-cytoscape-dagre.txt). It contains the dagre
                          and graphlib libraries of the dagrejs project (@dagrejs/dagre 3, @dagrejs/graphlib 4;
                          MIT, (c) Chris Pettitt: LICENSE-dagre.txt, LICENSE-graphlib.txt).

Please cite Cytoscape.js when you publish what you made with it (its README asks for the first paper):
  Franz M, Lopes CT, Huck G, Dong Y, Sumer O, Bader GD (2016) Cytoscape.js: a graph theory library for
  visualisation and analysis. Bioinformatics 32(2): 309-311. doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btv557
  Franz M, Lopes CT, Fong D, Kucera M, Cheung M, Siper MC, Huck G, Dong Y, Sumer O, Bader GD (2023)
  Cytoscape.js 2023 update: a graph theory library for visualization and analysis. Bioinformatics 39(1):
  btad031. doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btad031
and the fCoSE layout, with the CoSE layout it builds on:
  Balci H, Dogrusoz U (2022) fCoSE: a fast compound graph layout algorithm with constraint support. IEEE
  Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics 28(12): 4582-4593. doi:10.1109/TVCG.2021.3095303
  Dogrusoz U, Giral E, Cetintas A, Civril A, Demir E (2009) A layout algorithm for undirected compound
  graphs. Information Sciences 179(7): 980-994. doi:10.1016/j.ins.2008.11.017

The Networks tab is the workbench's own (networks.js, net-algo.js, net-io.js); it is not Cytoscape, the
desktop program of the Cytoscape Consortium, though it reads and writes Cytoscape's files.
